I found nothing the contributor must fix, so this can be merged. The working tree is unchanged and the scratch directory is deleted.

**Checks**
- **Tests:** `pnpm vitest run packages/tailwindcss` passes: 42 files, 5017 tests passed, 1 skipped.
- **Formatting:** `npx prettier --check` on the four changed source files reports "All matched files use Prettier code style!"
- **Type check:** `tsc --noEmit` in `packages/tailwindcss` reports no errors in the changed files. Its only errors are "Cannot find module '@tailwindcss/oxide'", in `packages/@tailwindcss-webpack/src/index.ts`, `src/candidate.bench.ts`, `src/index.bench.ts` and `tests/ui.spec.ts`. None of those files are in this diff; the native module simply isn't built here.

**Behavior** (I compiled candidates directly against `src/index`)
- **Named values:**
  - `anchor-tooltip` gives `anchor-name: --tooltip`.
  - `anchored-tooltip` gives `position-anchor: --tooltip`.
- **Keywords:**
  - `anchor-none` gives `anchor-name: none`.
  - `anchored-auto` gives `position-anchor: auto`.
- **Arbitrary values:**
  - `anchor-[--a,--b]` gives `anchor-name: --a,--b`.
  - `anchored-[--a,--b]` gives `position-anchor: --a,--b`.
  - `anchor-(--x)` gives `anchor-name: var(--x)`.
  - `anchor-[--a_--b]` gives `--a --b`.
- **No CSS:** bare `anchor` and `anchored`, negative forms, modifiers (`anchor-tooltip/50`, `anchor-[--a]/50`, `anchored-auto/foo`), fractions and dotted values. The new tests cover all of these.
- **Variants and important:** `hover:anchor-a` and `anchor-x!` work as expected.
- **IntelliSense:** the class list snapshot gains exactly `anchor-none` and `anchored-auto`.
- **Sort order:** adding `anchor-name` and `position-anchor` to `property-order.ts` is how the repo orders utilities by property. Every utility's properties appear there (for example `isolation`), so this edit belongs in the PR.

**Nits**
- The CHANGELOG entry is the only one under Unreleased without a `([#NNNN](…))` PR link. It should get one once the PR number is known.
- The bare-value pattern allows a few odd names: `anchor---x` gives `----x`, `anchor-1` gives `--1`, `anchor-auto` gives `--auto` and `anchored-none` gives `--none`. These are valid dashed idents and the issue allows them.
